```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
library(ggplot2)
```

Each data set in the `ecodata26` package is documented in the [reference](https://noaa-edab.github.io/reference/) section. Many of the data sets have a similar structure. They are in long format and `ggplot2` can be used to quickly view them.

For figures as seen in the SOE reports please visit the [indicator catalog](https://noaa-edab.github.io/catalog/)

## Cold pool index data

```{r, warning = F}
ggplot(data = ecodata26::cold_pool) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Time,y=Value,color=as.factor(EPU))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Var),scales = "free_y")
```

## Acuaculture data

```{r, warning = F}
ggplot(data = ecodata26::aquaculture) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Time,y=Value,color=as.factor(Region))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Var),scales = "free_y")
```

## Zooplankton diversity index

```{r, warning = F}
ggplot(data = ecodata26::zoo_diversity) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Time,y=Value,color=as.factor(EPU))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Var),scales = "free_y")
```
